Marvin Gardens rent is $150 with one house. The opponent paid only $110 on Atlantic Avenue, so I will use that figure rather than the standard $130. They spent roughly $1200 on pink houses and about $154 to unmortgage St. Charles and States.

The opponent likely acquired the pink properties for free through bankruptcy auction or transfer, then spent $154 to unmortgage two of them and $1200 on houses. I am now on Community Chest and preparing to end my turn.

I am mapping my monopolies. I hold the yellow set with one house each, and all three orange properties are unmortgaged. I also own Park Place unmortgaged while Boardwalk remains mortgaged, so building there is not yet possible. The opponent's railroads add another $200 in rent.

I am calculating p3's possible rolls from Atlantic Avenue. They could land on my mortgaged Water Works, my one-house Marvin Gardens, or my unmortgaged Park Place for $35. I am weighing which of these would hit them hardest.

I am weighing whether to build more houses on my yellows. A roll of three would hit Marvin Gardens for $150, but that is only a 2/36 chance. I am also considering my own survival and which Community Chest I landed on this turn.
